Backbase:
Backbase is a leading engagement banking provider that helps banks modernize and orchestrate all customer touchpoints. It transforms siloed banking channels and legacy applications into a cohesive and deeply engaging banking experience.

Provided solutions for challenging cases where the requirements were difficult to achieve with the existing out-of-the-box products. Based on this analysis, designed the entire project architecture, including the number of services to be created and the communication strategy between them. Assisted customers with multiple proofs of concept prior to actual implementation, providing examples for reference during the real service deployment.
